objections.claim: At candidate sha256:d88ff717bb077d7fdc549a75f0d89cfd9deb811411a7b41820719ffa9ce18e92, the publish ceremony contradicts its numeric-release-ID invariant. It requires every view/upload/verify/flip/delete operation to target the bound release ID because multiple drafts may share a tag, but its closed-allowlist check uses `gh release view --json assets`. That command accepts only an optional tag; without one it inspects the latest release and cannot select a numeric release ID. The ceremony can therefore validate another release and then publish the unvalidated bound draft. Replace this with the ID-addressed REST endpoint and add a regression where a competing draft/latest release proves the assets inspected belong to the exact bound ID.
